svg.title: Same four rays, two expanding trees
svg.desc: Numerical solutions of the planar expander ODE at t=1. A blue tree has a horizontal central edge; an orange tree has a vertical central edge. Each has two 120-degree triple junctions and approaches the same dashed diagonal rays. The trees differ with the four ends held fixed, and are related by a quarter-turn. All ends continue to infinity.
svg.text: Same four rays, two expanding trees
Numerical ODE profiles in ℝ² · t = 1 · equal horizontal and vertical scales
Two triple junctions · four unbounded ends
At positive time: Σₜ = √t Σ₁. The two trees differ with the ends held fixed.
